title: Finiteness of the layered circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates have distinct arguments and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. Every layer of the layered circuit associated to $C$ has finitely many nodes.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
